recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current core source fix is needed for FHIR-7975; any future entity type search parameter would need a new work-group decision against the current Provenance model.
issue_request: FHIR-7975 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core Provenance change request to add `entity` and `entitytype` query parameters for Provenance.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git commit 4f363ad0bd, the SVN revision 5534 commit cited in Jira, which added Provenance spreadsheet Search rows for `entity` and `entitytype`; a later cleanup renamed `entitytype` to `entity-type` while it still targeted Provenance.entity.type.
additional_context: FHIR-9996 later changed Provenance.entity.reference to Reference(Any) and removed Provenance.entity.type/display. Its implementation commit d6bec27176 marked Provenance.entity.type and the entity-type search parameter inactive and changed the entity search parameter to a reference search. The current build-scope Provenance source defines the surviving entity search parameter on Provenance.entity.what, and the current StructureDefinition has no Provenance.entity.type element.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Re-adding an entitytype/entity-type search parameter would refer to a removed element and would conflict with the later published Provenance model; the applicable current entity query parameter is already present.

related_jiras.note: Published Provenance model change that removed Provenance.entity.type and explains why the old entitytype/entity-type search parameter is no longer current.
